QF.id: Cat III AIF Overview and Growth_1

question.text: Category III AIFs are UNIQUELY defined by which capability?

answer.text: Leverage through F&O/derivatives/arbitrage, including in both listed and unlisted derivatives

explanation.text: The Logic: Cat III AIFs are permitted leverage via F&O, structured products, arbitrage — unique among AIF categories. The Trap: Other features are common across categories. Cross-Exam Context: Key distinguishing feature between Cat I/II (XIX-A) and Cat III (XIX-B). Distributor's Pro-Tip: Highlight leverage capability when positioning Cat III AIFs for sophisticated investors.
